chapter_seo_title: Han Li’s New Master Reveals a Hidden Inheritance in RMJI Chapter 240
chapter_meta_description: Han Li formally becomes Li Huayuan’s disciple. But the real prize is a golden page that finally begins to unravel the mystery of the silver page, only to reveal a shocking secret.
og_title: A New Discipleship and an Ancient Secret
og_description: In Chapter 240 of A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality, Han Li gains a master, loses a mystery, and then finds an even bigger one.
twitter_title: Han Li’s new golden page holds a secret that blows his mind.
twitter_description: Han Li becomes a formal disciple and uses fire to unlock a hidden layer from his silver page—but the truth is more frustrating than he imagined.

lore_anchors.definition: A foundational cultivation technique for Qi Condensation disciples. Abilities tied to this art prioritize defense and survival, such as creating a magical “Spirit Armor.”
A cultivation technique whose signature ability, "Phantom Projection," allows the user to create illusory copies of themselves to confuse and mislead enemies.
A form of sharp, concentrated sword-light projected from a flying sword, representing the highest level of a Sword Cultivator's art. It is far more destructive than a simple magical tool slash.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Han Li choose the golden page when there were better techniques?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He recognized its identical format to his mysterious silver page, betting that solving that riddle is more valuable than any standard combat art.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What was the point of Han Li’s “thank you for teaching” gift?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It formally cleared his life-debt to the Master’s Wife, allowing a “clean” transaction into formal discipleship where his only obligation is to his master.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why was Han Li so angry about the Sword Aura technique?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He already cultivates the Azure Origin Sword Aura and does not want to waste time on a lower-tier variant; he saw it as a dead end to his mystery.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What does the absorption of Han Li’s attack mean for the golden page?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It proves the page is not a simple manual and likely contains a hidden inheritance or a powerful seal that reacts to Sword Aura, reviving the mystery.
